dialogue: "Okay so... quick question about when I'm supposed to activate it..."
"Should I do it when there's still people here? Or should I wait until everyone is at home?"
"Wait until you think everyone is gone. We need it to get accustomed to its environment before it integrates."
"Doesn't it all already know what's going on?"
"I think it would be fine to do it when people are already here, then I can introduce it."
"Please, just follow what I say and don't get too caught up on the minor details, it'll all work out."
"Thank you for giving me this opportunity, Jane."
"I promise to make our company thrive!"
